free_tier.stated: No per-account quota published or enforced (395,436,915 observations live at time of probe). But per-object: 20 MB/file upload cap, AND every image is re-encoded to a 2048 px longest edge. So the stored 'original' is not your original.

egress.terms: free, no auth, static.inaturalist.org serves 5 sizes; API 100 req/min (asked to stay at 60)

record.interface_detail: REST v1 + v2. POST /v1/observation_photos and POST /v1/photos accept multipart `file`; pyinaturalist wraps it.
record.chaining: Good write API, bad read fidelity. Every returned photo is ≤2048 px; the size ladder is square/large/medium/small/original and 'original' is a misnomer.
record.limits_note: 20 MB/file; downsample to 2048×2048 max on the longest edge; API 100 req/min

identity_cost.detail: Email. Verified the live signup form at /users/new: user[login], user[email], user[password] only, plus a reCAPTCHA widget. No affiliation field exists.

record.reliability_note: Measured on a live asset: /photos/753863865/original.jpg = 3,881,965 bytes at dimensions reported as 1536×2048, i.e. already clamped. Mods state plainly: 'That term [original] is probably misleading ... everything larger is reduced to 2048.'

evidence.proved: total_results 395436915; photo objects carry original_dimensions {width,height} capped at 2048
